name: Broccoli Mushroom Egg Fu Young with Steamed Rice & Vegetarian Gravy

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Combine broth, soy sauce, vinegar, and oil in a small saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
1 tbsp soy sauce
½ tsp rice vinegar
1 tsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Combine additional broth and corn starch in a small bowl; whisk to combine a smooth slurry. When broth in the saucepan comes to a boil, add slurry in a steady stream while whisking quickly. Let boil for 1 minute, then cover and reduce heat to low; simmer the gravy for 30 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 fl oz (¼ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
1 tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to another small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup jasmine rice
1 cup water
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ crown broccoli
¼ lb white mushrooms
½ small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Slice mushrooms. Peel and thinly slice yellow onion into half rings.
Preheat an ovenproof skillet over high heat.
Preheat oven to broil on high; position rack under the broiler.
When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the vegetables and salt; cook, stirring often, until tender-crisp, 5-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Crack eggs into a medium bowl; add vinegar, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 eggs
1 tsp rice vinegar
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse water chestnuts; thinly slice into rounds.

Stir water chestnuts into the skillet with the veggies. Reduce heat to medium-high and pour egg mixture evenly over the top. Let cook, undisturbed, until the bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 4-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Place skillet in the oven and cook until top is set and golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove from the oven and slice into wedges.
To serve, divide rice and egg fu young between dishes. Pour gravy over the egg fu young and top with green onions. Enjoy!
